scenes.say: Why do we normalize or denormalize data? Which approach is best for your database?

scenes.label: Normalize
scenes.sub: Organizes data, cuts redundancy, boosts integrity.
scenes.say: Normalization organizes your data, cuts redundancy, and improves integrity.

scenes.label: Denormalize
scenes.sub: Combines tables for speed, adds redundancy.
scenes.say: Denormalization combines tables for speed, but adds some redundancy.
Normalize for less redundancy and better consistency, but expect slower queries. Denormalize for faster reads, but watch for data anomalies.
Normalize for online transaction processing. Denormalize for analytics and reporting workloads.

scenes.question: Why not always normalize?
scenes.right: Too much normalization can slow queries with complex joins.
scenes.say: Why not always normalize? Too much normalization can slow down queries that need lots of joins.
